reviews.title: Honor your coupon codes!
reviews.text: Never honors coupon codes for Steward members

reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text: So much worse than they used to be. In two ways:  (1) technically/UI. Every time I try to use it, it doesn’t remember my password, and makes me create a new one. Absolutely stupid and annoying. (2) they no longer offer discounts that are worth anything. I used to get flat 10-20% discount offers all the time. Now at most it’s 10% except it doesn’t work for any of the wines on their site (anything ending in a 7, which is almost all of them).

reviews.title: Bad app and bad service
reviews.text: The app deleted my cart so I can’t order what I wanted. And all discounts are not usable since all wines are non discounted. I used to love wine dot.com. Now I order sometimes but prefer other sites or stores. You’ll soon lose me as a customer

reviews.title: Out of everything
reviews.text: You’re consistently out of a ton of wines and are always advertising discounts and specials but every wine I choose is exempt from the discount.  Very disappointing

reviews.title: Ship date
reviews.text: Tried to select a different, shown as an available option; but app wouldn’t accept and save the selected date

reviews.title: Sales and discounts
reviews.text: How come every time I try to use a discount almost every bottle I select... comes back that it can't be discounted. Use to never have that happen. Now happens all the time. After 10 years I'm done

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: As a long time customer I note that most of the discount coupons only are for non-registered users.  Offers that are provided like JAN25 entice you to order, only to find a lot of restrictions pre-emptying their use.  I’m considering switching to a different vendor.

reviews.title: Ordering system does not work well
reviews.text: It has been frustrating to order wine with the discount codes, I keep getting error messages

reviews.title: False Coupons
reviews.text: The coupons you flaunt when logging in for members always have limitations/stipulations that allow you to pick and choose how much you really have to spend before they can be redeemed, shady…..
